question: What is the term used to refer to the process of conversion of water vapour back to water?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Condensation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The process of conversion of water vapour back to water is called Condensation**. 
 
• Condensation takes place__:
 __
 
• when the temperature of the air is reduced to dew point with its volume remaining constant.
 
• when both the volume and the temperature are reduced.
 
• when moisture is added to the air through evaporation.
 
 
 
• After condensation the water vapour becomes — **dew, frost, fog and clouds**.

 [IMAGE: https://www.pmfias.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/01/Fog-forms-of-condensation.jpg] [IMAGE: https://www.lordgrey.org.uk/~f014/usefulresources/aric/Resources/Teaching_Packs/Key_Stage_4/Weather_Climate/images/04a.jpg] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Evaporation:**__ ​Evaporation is a process by which water is transformed from** liquid to gaseous state**.
 
• __**Factors Affecting Rate of Evaporation:**__
 
 
• Amount of water available.
 
• Temperature.
 
• Wind Speed.
 
• Air pressure.
 
• Composition of water.
